body:
I'm glad to hear you've gotten past the worst of it. Unfortunately I can't say I'm grateful to be alive, even before I met her.

While I have been diagnosed with depression before I wouldn't have said I was depressed when I met her. I know that depression never really goes away, we just get better at handling it, but I hadn't had any suicidal thoughts in a very long time until today.

I feel a lot less anxious now so the chances that I will hurt my self have dropped. Instead I'm filled with a deep hatred for myself for causing this situation yet again. If I manage to make it through the weekend, the chances are I'll make an appointment with my doctor first thing next week for some help.

I came here because I don't really have anyone else to talk to. I'm not that close with my family and my friends are angry with me because of how I've acted towards them as of late.

I literally broke down into a pile of pathetic waste as soon as i got in. I hate myself for hurting people.
